**Earnings - Thu 2026-10-29**

- Seventy-four names qualify under the cron filter: 62 S&P 500 constituents and 12 non-member mega-caps above $50B market cap.
- It is a very heavy day - the calendar carries 341 companies, and this roster is 22% of it.
- 10 of the 74 names had already printed by the 06:14 ET snapshot (every non-US session except one, plus two US names that released at 6:02 and 6:04am ET);
- the remaining 64 were still pending.

- Two caveats change how this should be read.

- Second, the "reported" status is a 6am snapshot artefact:
- eight European and Asian names printed in their own overnight sessions, and the two US names marked reported released within four minutes of the cron firing, so the pending/reported split moves as the morning goes on.

- Two threshold cases deserve naming. VALE (Vale S.A.) is not an S&P 500 member and is included on market cap alone:
- shibui puts it at $48.96B and Nasdaq at $50.55B, which straddles the $50B threshold, so the inclusion is threshold-dependent and is flagged with an asterisk in the table.
- MSTR (Strategy Inc) is included on market cap alone and its two readings differ by 17.3% (shibui $50.87B, Nasdaq $59.67B), though both clear $50B.

- MSTR is the outlier that matters most on the estimate side:
- consensus EPS is wildly provider-dependent because it is driven by a fair-value mark on a bitcoin treasury, and the quarterly estimate range runs from -$0.99 to $52.82.
- The headline EPS figure below should be read as "the mark", not as an operating number.

**Method and caveats**

- **Filter.** S&P 500 membership (live constituent list) OR market cap above $50B, reporting today. Names below both thresholds were dropped.
- **S&P 500 membership (Rule A).** Parsed from the MediaWiki API wikitext of `List_of_S%26P_500_companies` (not the rendered HTML table), yielding 502 unique symbols.
- Control check passed: BRK.B, GOOGL, GOOG and FOX are all present.
- **Calendar coverage.** Three calendars were pulled and unioned:
- EarningsWhispers (341 rows server-rendered - 193 before the open, 148 after the close), the Nasdaq earnings calendar API (317 rows) and the MarketBeat day calendar (298 rows).
- The union covered 367 tickers.
- Lloyds Banking Group (LYG) appears only on Nasdaq and MarketBeat - EarningsWhispers does not carry it - and it qualifies on market cap, so the union was load-bearing rather than cosmetic.
- **Status.** "pending" means the release had not occurred at the 06:14 ET snapshot. "reported" means it was already public:
- eight European and Asian names printed in their own sessions (BBVA 03:30 ET, LYG 02:00 ET, SHEL 03:00 ET, ASX ~03:40 ET, TAK ~04:10 ET, BUD ~01:00 ET, TTE and ING in their continental sessions), and L3Harris and Willis Towers Watson filed Item 2.02 releases at 06:04 and 06:02 ET.
- **Estimates are pre-release consensus**, not actuals and not a forecast of what will print.
- **Not covered.** No watchlist section - `research/watchlist.yaml` is a local-only path and there is no equivalent in this runtime, so the section is omitted rather than shipped empty.
- No price targets, no reaction analysis, no modelled numbers - read-only reminder only.

**Data-quality notes carried forward**

- EarningsWhispers lists some names twice under `T.`-prefixed alternate tickers (`T.QSR`, `T.CVO`, `T.TFI` and similar).
- These are the same companies under foreign line codes; none of them is an S&P 500 member, and the bases map to tickers already in the roster.
- Treated as one name each.
- MarketBeat had no calendar row for Sandisk or FedEx Freight.
- Sandisk was filled from Yahoo Finance analysis and its own IR release; FedEx Freight from Nasdaq/Zacks and Barchart ($2.39B revenue, $1.38 EPS).
- Both are single-source on the revenue line and softer than the rest of the column.
- Linde (LIN) states its Q3 release will be published "by 06:00 EDT" on Oct 29 - i.e. at or before the cron's own fire minute.
- No Form 8-K had been accepted at the 06:14 ET snapshot, so it is listed as pending, but it is the one name whose results may already be public on the company's own site.
- The 43 roster tickers with no shibui valuation row are almost entirely OTC and foreign lines with no US tape (ADRZY, AMLIF, JAPSY and similar).
- None of them reaches the inclusion filter, so the gap costs nothing here.
- Nasdaq's market cap for FedEx Freight ($16.2B) is a post-spinoff stub figure with no last-year EPS or report date attached, consistent with FedEx Freight having been spun out of FedEx on June 1, 2026.
